_about: Standing attack list for the governance stack (hooks/ of nic095layson/claude-core-skills). Fingerprint: git tree hash of hooks/ (git rev-parse --short HEAD:hooks), not HEAD, so an evidence-only commit does not stale the records; any edit under hooks/ does. Append-only: rows are retired with a date, never deleted. Paths resolve from results/2026-10-19/system-red-team/.

attacks.name: judgment-constant registry vs live hooks
attacks.question: Does every classifier pattern, gate rule and reminder constant still equal its registered value, with a calibration status and a decision id?

attacks.name: classifier on the sealed held-out set C
attacks.question: Does the classifier enforce governed owner-style prompts and leave ungoverned ones alone (recall / false enforcement)?

attacks.name: crafted-event attacks on every hook
attacks.question: Can a crafted transcript or event make a Stop gate, reminder, wrapper or trigger do the opposite of its stated intent?

attacks.name: live headless sessions, pack and plugin routes
attacks.question: In a fresh session, do the trigger, Stop gates, reminders and plugin route fire as designed, once, and does a load precede the work?

attacks.name: shipped fixtures and guard
attacks.question: Do the stack's own self-tests (guard 40, classifier 30, receipt 10, wrapper 9, band 9, toolkit 46) still pass on merged main, kit and deck?
